chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a Moroccan man in his early 30s, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow knit polo shirt and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s, a teacher, wearing a dusty-pink hijab and a long emerald-green cardigan over a cream dress
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a Moroccan woman in her late 30s, wearing a burgundy hijab and a grey house djellaba with white trim, apron tied on
chars.ADOUL: ADOUL: an older Moroccan notary with a white beard, white djellaba and red fez

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan apartment living room, the WIFE stands in front of the seated HUSBAND, smiling insistently and holding out her open palm toward him while holding a wedding-hall brochure in the other hand; he looks up at her uneasily. Medium shot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: the HUSBAND and WIFE sit side by side at a small table signing a marriage contract in front of the ADOUL, who holds out a pen; the wife looks pleased, the husband slightly nervous. Warm Moroccan interior with zellige tiles.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The WIFE sits close to the HUSBAND on a Moroccan sofa with a packed suitcase next to her, sweetly pleading with clasped hands and puppy eyes; he scratches his head.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Comic shock: the WIFE calmly shows the HUSBAND a long handwritten list on paper, while the HUSBAND's eyes pop wide and his jaw drops, nearly spilling his glass of mint tea. Living room.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The WIFE walks happily out of a Moroccan shop carrying many colorful shopping bags full of gifts, her hijab freshly styled, a bus ticket peeking from her purse. Busy Moroccan street with shopfronts in the background, no readable signs.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND sits alone at the kitchen table staring sadly at his empty open wallet and a single bank card, shoulders slumped, comic gloomy mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND on a balcony at dusk facepalming with one hand, shaking his head at himself, Moroccan rooftops behind him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND visits his SISTER in her Moroccan kitchen; she stirs a tagine while turning toward him with a stern, knowing look as he talks with open hands.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: The SISTER points a wooden spoon at the HUSBAND, lecturing him firmly; the HUSBAND sits on a stool with his chin in his hand, thinking hard and worried. Moroccan kitchen.
